_SAMPLER_WARNING: TWO separate misreads in this taxonomy came from HOW I SAMPLED, not from Mike: (1) taking frame 0 of an effect reel shows a 4px spark, which made the explosion set look like a decal; (2) looking up a FAMILY name with no frame index returns nothing, which made nine real thruster reels and a whole weapon set look missing. When rendering a family for identification, take a MID-REEL frame and resolve the index.
